{{Short description|German philosopher and political economist}}
[[File:Ludwig von Beausobre 1779 von Daniel Nikolaus Chodowiecki (Inventor, Zeichner), Daniel Berger (Stecher).png|thumb|upright=0.9|Louis de Beausobre, 1779, by Daniel Nikolaus Chodowiecki]]
'''Louis Isaac de Beausobre''' (19 August 1730 – 3 December 1783) was a German philosopher and political economist of French [[Huguenot]] descent. He was born in [[Berlin]], the son of the French Protestant churchman and ecclesiastical historian [[Isaac de Beausobre]] and his second wife, Charlotte Schwarz. He is not to be confused with his elder half-brother, the pastor and theologian Charles Louis de Beausobre (1690–1753).

Beausobre was educated at the [[Französisches Gymnasium Berlin|Collège Français]] in Berlin, where he was taught and greatly influenced by [[Johann Heinrich Samuel Formey]]. He went on to study philosophy at [[Frankfurt (Oder)|Frankfurt an der Oder]], and later in [[Paris]]. On his return to Berlin he was received as a member of the [[Prussian Academy of Sciences]] in 1755.

[[Frederick the Great]], out of esteem for Isaac de Beausobre, became the guardian of his son Louis de Beausobre, and supported him in his studies.

==Works==
* ''Dissertations philosophiques, dont la première roule sur la nature du feu, et la seconde sur les différentes parties de la philosophie et des mathématiques'' (1753) [http://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k952802.pdf Online text]
* ''Le Pyrrhonisme du sage'' (1754)
* ''Le Pyrrhonisme raisonnable'' (1755) (a second edition of ''Le Pyrrhonisme du sage'') [http://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k95285s.pdf Online text]
* ''Nouvelles considérations sur les années climatériques, la longueur de la vie de l’homme, la propagation du genre humain, et la vraie puissance des États, considérée dans la plus grande population'' (1757) [http://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k64581.pdf Online text]
* ''Essai sur le bonheur, ou Réflexions philosophiques sur les biens et les maux de la vie humaine'' (1758) [http://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k812968.pdf Online text]
* ''Introduction générale à l'étude de la politique, des finances et du commerce'' (1764) [http://hermes-ir.lib.hit-u.ac.jp/da/handle/123456789/5427 Online text]
* "Réflexions sur la nature et les causes de la folie", published in 5 parts in ''Histoire de l'Académie royale des sciences et des belles-lettres'' for 1759 and 1760 (1766-7)
* "Réflexions sur les songes", published in ''Histoire de l'Académie royale des sciences et des belles-lettres'' for 1762 (1769)
* "Sur l'enthusiasme", published in ''Nouveaux Mémoires de l'Académie royale'' for 1779 (1781)
